_comment: The Spider Queen at the end of the spiders' den under Sorrowfen (content-zone-7-swamp.md §2.2, C6): a group boss for 2-3 players, built on BroodMother (venom, a fear screech, splits into Spiders on death) plus the giant spider's web. The kill target of the-spider-queen. Immune to miasma like the swamp's other spiders. Wears the GiantSpider sprite at a larger body until her own art lands. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
name: SpiderQueen
